svg.title: AXIVAI approach: start with the need, not the truck
svg.desc: AXIVAI’s five-step approach, shown with two example sites with the same fleet of 40 buses needing 4,000 kWh a day. Step 1 verifies the need. Step 2 assesses alternatives, including options that don’t involve AXIVAI. Site A, with 400 kW of spare grid power, stops here: managed charging covers the night and no AXIVAI is needed. Site B, with 150 kW spare, continues: managed charging and a battery alone fall short, so energy must come in. Step 3 selects stationed power with occasional top-up deliveries. Step 4 covers electrical design, permits, grid interconnection review and commissioning; permits can recreate the delay. Step 5 measures service against the need; AXIVAI has no results yet. Results refine the next assessment.
